mentions.name: Buffalo
mentions.description: Buffalo is a text-based social media platform with no UI and no algorithm, so users can view and filter posts however they want, including by tags; frontends can be built as websites or TUIs. A waitlist is available.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Buffalo, a text based social media with no UI, and no algorithm meaning you can view posts how ever you want and filter them by tags, if you want to view it through a website you can make one, if you want to view it through a TUI you can make one.
mentions.author: R1shy
